entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: ¶By the rivers of Babylon we were seated, weeping at the memory of Zion,

entries.title: Psalms 137:2
segments: Hanging our instruments of music on the trees by the waterside.

entries.title: Psalms 137:3
segments: For there those who had taken us prisoners made request for a song; and those who had taken away all we had gave us orders to be glad, saying, Give us one of the songs of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:4
segments: How may we give the Lord's song in a strange land?

entries.title: Psalms 137:5
segments: If I keep not your memory, O Jerusalem, let not my right hand keep the memory of its art.

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: If I let you go out of my thoughts, and if I do not put Jerusalem before my greatest joy, let my tongue be fixed to the roof of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: ¶O Lord, keep in mind against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem; how they said, Let it be uncovered, uncovered even to its base.

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments: O daughter of Babylon, whose fate is destruction; happy is the man who does to you what you have done to us.

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: Happy is the man who takes your little ones, crushing them against the rocks.
